title: GTA6 Introduces Headphones for Radio and Podcasts on Foot
description: For the first time in the series, GTA6 will let players listen to radio stations and on-demand podcasts on foot using connected headphones and earbuds.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Introduces Headphones for Radio and Podcasts on Foot

According to a recent report by gaming outlet Eurogamer, *Grand Theft Auto 6* will feature a groundbreaking addition to the series' iconic audio design, allowing players to enjoy radio stations and audio entertainment while away from vehicles for the first time.

### A New Era of Open-World Audio

Historically, the rich selection of radio stations has been tied directly to vehicles in the *GTA* universe. Once players stepped out of a car, the music and talk shows would fade away, leaving only the ambient sounds of the city. Eurogamer's report indicates that GTA6 will completely overhaul this limitation.

Players will now be able to use headphones and earbuds connected to their in-game smartphones. This new mechanic means you can keep the tunes rolling, listen to your favorite DJs, or tune into broadcasts while walking, exploring, or engaging in open-world activities on foot.

### On-Demand Podcasts Debut

In addition to traditional radio stations, the report reveals that GTA6 is introducing **on-demand podcasts**. While exact details remain brief, this feature allows players to binge content such as true crime while navigating the criminal underworld of the game. It is a modern touch that mirrors contemporary media consumption habits directly inside the game's satirical universe.

### Editor's Take

This small yet impactful addition highlights Rockstar Games' commitment to immersive open-world design. By bridging the gap between vehicle-locked audio and on-foot exploration, GTA6 is set to make every moment in the game world feel vibrant and entertaining. It is these thoughtful details that continue to set the franchise apart.
